parsed.why: No national criminalisation, but local dress-code ordinances with imprisonment, police arrests of Pride participants, birth-sex custody with head-shaving, and documented trans killings; patchwork ordinances and strong urban acceptance partially offset.

Statutory self-declaration, conversion ban, long liberal record; but hate incidents up 42% and survey shows 1 in 5 trans people threatened, 8% physically attacked — episodic hostility in a protective state.

No criminalisation and court-recognised identity, but implementation gaps, documented harassment and assault of visibly trans people in provincial cities, entrenched stigma, and rising political hostility.

Felony sodomy statutes (up to 14 years) capture trans women read as male; no trans protections or recognition; enforcement unrecorded since 2013; documented third-gender tradition and no recorded violence temper a thin record.

Cross-dressing criminalised plus felony sodomy; no recognition; documented state extrajudicial killings, torture and official discrimination of LGBTQIA+ people, vigilante attacks; death penalty abolished 2020 only.
